title: Oxford-Cambridge researchers flag ChatGPT's 'big problem'; Michael Burry agrees

title: 30-something heart: Inside a threefold spike striking young India

A recent survey indicates a threefold rise in heart-related ailments from 2017-2018 to 2025. Conditions like hypertension and diabetes are contributing factors for this rise. Unforeseen heart issues are emerging in individuals with no prior risk factors, showcasing a concerning trend. Urgent medical interventions are increasingly required for younger patients facing severe cardiac conditions.

title: Why children copy their parents’ habits and emotions, according to psychology

Through observational learning, they grasp essential skills like communication and emotional regulation from daily exchanges. While parents significantly influence their kids' perceptions of relationships, they don't need to be flawless. Parental missteps can impart critical lessons about overcoming difficulties and mending bonds, establishing a strong foundation for children's growth.

title: Gulveer completes medal hat-trick at Asian Games; secures bronze in 5,000m
content:
Gulveer Singh

Gulveer Singh keeps running into medals. Well, he really does. The Indian athlete added a third medal to his tally at the 2026 Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya, winning bronze in the men's 5000m on Tuesday. The Indian long-distance runner had earlier won silver medals in the men's 1500m and 10,000m events. With his latest bronze in 5,000m, Gulveer now has three medals from three athletics events at the ongoing Asian Games. Gulveer thus became the second Indian man and fourth from the country to win three medals in track and field events in a single edition of the continental games. Before Gulveer, Lavy Pinto (New Delhi 1951, 3 medals), PT Usha (Seoul, 1986, 4 medals) and KM Beenamol (Busan 2002, 3 medals) had achieved a similar feat. Gulveer clocked 13:32.75 to secure the third place. While Bahrain's Birhanu Balew clinched the gold medal with 13:30.79, Japan's Tomonori Yamaguchi won the silver with 13:31.43.

End of Article

title: Eiffel Tower chief to quit after female staff excluded during Hindu group's visit
